content:
Omar: Heads-up — after the deterministic coalesce rollout I'm seeing a p95 drift on small-hosted models. Suspect microbatch alignment + kernel hot-switching causing KV cache thrash.
Maya: Can you paste the perf snapshot and the config we rolled?
Omar: Quick summary: p50 18ms -> 20ms, p95 320ms -> 410ms, KV hit rate 87% -> 73% on a handful of high-QPS shards. Kernel switch rate +45% (per-shard counters). No clear GC or infra CPU spike.
Maya: ouch. any repro locally?
Omar: I did a local canary with a randomized holdtime variant (harmonic jitter, per-shard seed). Observed p95 come down to ~330ms and KV hit back to ~82%. Kernel switches reduced ~20%.
Jen: harmonic jitter? how implemented?
Omar: We spread microbatch phase to avoid many requests aligning at the same offset — simple discrete offsets + per-shard seed so it stays stable per-hotshard. Implemented as a small bucketed jitter set. Example of current rollout config snapshot: 
```yaml
microbatch:
  holdtime_ms: 6
  jitter: "none"  # current in prod
  coalesce_policy: deterministic
token_budget_target: 256
```
Omar: And the experimental jitter payload I used in the canary: 
```json
{"holdtime_ms":6,"jitter_strategy":"harmonic","jitter_buckets":[0,1,2,4],"seed_per_shard":true,"scale_pct":0.3}
```
Sam: Nice. Do we have telemetry for jitter_bucket in logs so we can correlate KV hit by bucket?
Omar: Not yet — will add a small tag emit (jitter_bucket) and a histogram. I already have a draft PR.
Jen: What are abort conditions for a canary?
Omar: Proposal:
- Canary on 5% traffic, 2h window.
- Abort if p95 >= 1.05x baseline OR KV hit < 80% OR kernel_switch_rate > +30%
- Also fail fast if error_rate > 3x normal.
Sam: Can we gate further by kernel-switch counters (per-GPU) to avoid cross-shard noise?
Maya: Also test per-client vs per-shard seeding; per-client may cause too much variance for caching.
Omar: Agreed — start per-shard only. If stable, try per-client in a separate AB test.
Jen: I'll schedule the canary and run a profiler sampling sequence (3 x 30s profiles) to capture kernel selection churn.
Omar: Here's the curl I'll use to flip the rollout flag for the canary (internal API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.local/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"feature":"harmonic_jitter","on":true,"pct":5}'
```
perf-bot: perf-bot: Alert rule created: p95_latency >= 1.05 * baseline -> notify #eng-oncall and page if sustained > 5m
Maya: Good. We should also run a short offline replay against a high-QPS trace to validate KV hit impact without user traffic.
Omar: I'll kick off a replay job against the hot trace bundle, attach results to the PR.
Jen: I'll collect kernel counts and KV hit heatmaps for both deterministic and harmonic.
Sam: Can we include a cooldown to avoid rapid toggles? e.g., require stable metrics for 10m before expanding pct.
Omar: yes — plan: ramp 5% -> 20% after 30m stable -> 50% after 1h stable. Cooldown 10m between changes.
Maya: thanks. pls add runbook steps and the abort checklist to the PR description.
Omar: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 (telemetry + config + test harness).
Jen: I'll pick up the profiler collection after the canary is scheduled.
Omar: Thanks everyone. Posting the quick perf snapshot and will update once I have replay + PR results. :thumbsup:
